call_purpose: You wanted your coupon code to work at checkout for the Advanced Course, the company name on your invoice's GST part corrected, and your coupon's expiry date extended.

resolved.text: Following our guidance, you assigned the Advanced Course to your coupon in the Products section of the coupon settings and saved it, and you confirmed the discount now shows at checkout.

covered.text: We explained that your coupon was assigned only to the Starter Course and not the Advanced Course, so the Advanced Course needed to be assigned.
We explained that you can extend the coupon's expiry date yourself in the coupon settings, where the date option is.

customer_next_steps.text: Extend the coupon's expiry date in the coupon settings.

support_next_steps.text: We will check the company name on your invoice's GST part with our billing team and let you know.
support_next_steps.timeline: by the day after our call
